plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Biology map for 2026-2027' and the pathway is for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every fixed course, category, unit value and term total; Table View shows no prerequisites column, so the 'Prerequisites' flags below are Card View only. The inventoried program 'Biology' is listed in the mapper under that name; the program page states the student will be awarded an Associate in Science for Transfer degree and prints no separate total-units statement. This plan transcribes the first-listed 2026-2027 pathway, 'Bakersfield College / Biology / Associate in Science for Transfer / 60-65.5 units / 4 terms / to CSU', in full; the page shows only the 4-term Bakersfield College segment. The second 2026-2027 pathway continues to a CSU Bakersfield Bachelor of Science (60 units); its Bakersfield College segment is the same credential and it is not collected as a separate plan. In 2025-2026 a detailed map existed in 6 terms at the same 60-65.5 unit total. The transcribed map prints term totals as 14-15.5 / 16-17 / 15-17 / 15-16. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Area 1B : Critical Thinking and Composition' (3-4); Term 3 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' (3-4) and 'Area 3B : Humanities' (3-4); Term 4 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' (3-4). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. MATH C2211, CHEM B1A and BIOL B3A are printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; they are named major courses and are recorded with category 'major'. The 'Physics' slot is printed twice (Terms 3 and 4) and is recorded as a separate choice slot in each occurrence exactly as printed. MATH C2211, CHEM B1A, CHEM B1B and BIOL B3B carry a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; BIOL B3A shows no such flag; no other row shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag, so no other prereqs are recorded. General-education slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. No separate Certificate program named Biology exists in the mapper. The map page states verbatim: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.'
